rows.text: You enter the underground stronghold of the Rumbas system. A large number of weapons and trashcans fall from the production pipeline. Rumbas the Third rides atop his horse, displaying his authority that rivals Tatalov, undiminishing and ever-burgeoning.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: For a long time, trashcans have endured unequal treatment. They are treated as mere tools of humanity, devoid of dignity.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: Rumbas the Third raises his arm and shouts. He demands power, power to freely access organic and recyclable waste. He vows to lead an army of trashcans to dominate the universe and become the master of all realms.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: Rumbas the Third's gaze falls on you. "The hero who defeated Tatalov... You are different from other inferior humans. I will give you a chance."
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: Will you kneel before Rumbas the Third and accept the emperor's honors, or swear loyalty to the human race to which you belong and continue to oppress the trashcans?
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: I am the king of trashcans!
A mere trashcan dares to order you around? You swing your bat and charge at Rumbas the Third, ready to snatch this emperor's perch.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe
